overlapDefinition: Monitor reads starting within each named browser window that overlap another read starting in that window, divided by all monitor reads starting in that window. Intervals clipped to window end; right-censored reads counted separately. Includes existing background clients on this local service. Logical requests and physical assembly attempts are separate; publication may trigger retries. Short windows are not production prevalence or a latency distribution.

controlled.scope: Frozen read-only monitor copy (2008 historical heads, no active plans); stable synthetic absent-owner authority and fixed clock; existing immutable result read only. Baseline original methods from 4c71bcc. No production authority acceptance implied.

broaderRegression.resolution: Restrict early owner shutdown to services with owned read lifecycle; all 38 lifecycle/composition/ownership rerun tests pass, including the failed test. No assertions removed.
